mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.coeat_id, c.parent_id, c.user_id, c.content, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM comment c JOIN root r ON c.id = r.id AND r.type = 'COMMENT' AND ORDER BY r.created_at DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.coeat_id, c.parent_id, c.user_id, c.content, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM comment c JOIN root r ON c.id = r.id AND r.type = 'COMMENT' AND WHERE c.coeat_id = #{coeatId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.coeat_id, c.parent_id, c.user_id, c.content, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM comment c JOIN root r ON c.id = r.id AND r.type = 'COMMENT' AND WHERE c.content = #{coeatId} AND c.parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (id, coeat_id, parent_id, user_id, content) VALUES (#{id}, #{coeatId}, #{parentId}, #{userId}, #{content})
